create_c2_name_converter: create a function that converts Caffe2 layer names to PyTorch layer names using regex rules
convert_caffe2_to_pytorch: convert a Caffe2 checkpoint layer name to its PyTorch equivalent format
convert_nonlocal_conv_names: convert Caffe2 nonlocal convolution layer names to PyTorch slowfast naming convention
convert_batchnorm_attributes: convert Caffe2 batchnorm attribute suffixes like bn_s, bn_b, bn_rm to PyTorch format
convert_temporal_fusion_names: convert Caffe2 temporal fusion and pathway1 layer names to PyTorch slowfast format
